title: The Sealed Laboratory
subtitle: Nobody entered. The sample is still gone.
briefing: A controlled biological sample is removed from a sealed containment laboratory. The room requires two independent authorisations to open, both of which are logged, and neither was used that night. The internal camera shows an empty room for the entire period. The sample is simply present at 3:00 AM and absent at 3:40 AM.
solution: Nobody entered because nobody needed to. Dr Ilse Unterberg had reprogrammed the automated sample-handling arm three days earlier to move the vial into an outgoing waste cassette at 3:12 AM. The camera showed an empty room because the room was empty. She collected the cassette from the loading dock the following morning through an entirely ordinary process nobody thinks to watch.

suspects.name: Dr Ilse Unterberg
suspects.motive: Her funding was terminated and the sample is the basis of her next application.

statements.question: Where were you that night?
statements.text: At home, asleep. My token has not been used since Tuesday evening.

statements.question: Was the two-key authorisation used?
statements.text: It was not. That is the point of it. Nobody opened that room.

statements.question: Was the handling arm operating?
statements.text: It runs a standard maintenance cycle overnight. It always has.

suspects.name: Dr Colin Frayne
suspects.relation: Holds one of the two keys
suspects.motive: Signed off a containment exemption for the sample a week earlier.

statements.question: Where were you that night?
statements.text: On call at home. I was not paged and I did not attend.

statements.question: Was the two-key authorisation used?
statements.text: No. And it cannot be used singly. That is the whole design.

statements.question: Was the handling arm operating?
statements.text: Robotics is not my discipline. I sign for containment, not code.

suspects.name: Nuno Ferreira
suspects.motive: Pushed a firmware update to the arm the same week.

statements.question: Where were you that night?
statements.text: At home. I have not been on site after six for a fortnight.

statements.question: Was the two-key authorisation used?
statements.text: Not according to the log, and I cannot use it at all.

statements.question: Was the handling arm operating?
statements.text: I pushed a firmware update on the Monday. Routine. The routines on it are not mine.

suspects.name: Dr Yara Haddad
suspects.motive: Would be named on the application the sample supports.

statements.question: Where were you that night?
statements.text: At home. I left at seven and my token log will say so.

statements.question: Was the two-key authorisation used?
statements.text: No. I checked the log myself when I heard.

statements.question: Was the handling arm operating?
statements.text: It runs overnight. We all assume it does nothing interesting.

The camera showed an empty room because the room was empty.
Follow the sample out of the building, not the person in.
